向量场 $A=(x^2y+y^3)\mathbf i+(x^3-xy^2)\mathbf j$ 的散度为（ ） $0$ $1$ $2$ $3$ $$P=x^2y+y^3,Q=x^3-xy^2,R=0$$

$$\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}=2xy,\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}=-2xy,\frac{\partial R}{\partial z}=0$$

$$\therefore\ divA=\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial R}{\partial z}=2xy-2xy=0$$
